title: Optimal Kinetic Exchange and Boltzmann Dynamics (Yakovenko)
research_question: Can voluntary optimal bilateral trades generate a kinetic exchange operator consistent with household budgets, rational expectations and market clearing?
feasibility_hypothesis: Conditional: exogenous random transfers conserve assets but do not generally arise from optimal trade; require gains from trade, matching frictions or a specified contractual market.
mechanisms: State-dependent bilateral matching with voluntary trade
Bargaining or price-taking mutually feasible exchanges
Transition kernel for pairwise post-trade holdings
Boltzmann gain-loss equation coupled with household saving
state_variables: liquid assets or money and consumption goods
aggregate goods, money and asset supply
required_equations: Bilateral post-trade financial asset conservation, accounting for external issuance
Both partners' budget constraints and participation constraints
Bellman optimality or bilateral Nash bargaining
Boltzmann collision operator and other household transition terms
comparison_baseline: Aiyagari/Huggett GE with kinetic matching shut off; separately exogenous Yakovenko exchange as non-optimal benchmark
acceptance_tests: Realized matches satisfy participation and individual budget constraints
Asset transfers net to zero in a closed pair; goods flows clear
Particle operator matches nonlinear Boltzmann transition operator
Zero-matching-rate switch-off recovers baseline prices and distribution
No exchange theorem/counterexample under frictionless homogeneous preferences
stage_gate: OPEN: neither full nonseparable joint GE nor endogenous bargaining prices or equilibrium selection solved. Restricted monetary search example is validated.

implementation.model: voluntary posted-price service-for-token search with optimal acceptance and stationary rational token values
implementation.solver: finite-state Bellman linear solve and stationary distribution nonlinear root
implementation.tests: 11 Stage 2 tests (nine matching and two product embedding), plus 6 Stage 0 tests
limitations: money does not convert into capital
posted price is restricted, not bargained
Foley transaction offers differ from search economy and money entropy

product_embedding.caveat: No capital-money convertibility, shared service labor, bargaining or nonseparable portfolio problem

stage2b.critical_competitor: Molico and Zhang 2006; Aruoba Waller Wright 2011
